# Shape ports

Every flowchart shape, 16 bracket shapes (b-) and Mermaid's 53 (m-), each with two
arrows in and three out (WO-59). The browser test (shape-ports.js) measures every arrow end
against the drawn outline in each direction and both looks; scene.js snapshots the first
diagram. A diamond's arrows meet its corners.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph g1 [Shapes 1 to 6]
    direction TB
    b-square-a["in A"]
    b-square-b["in B"]
    b-square["square<br>bracket"]

    b-square-y["Y"]
```
